annotations.title: Request an appointment or reservation by phone

description: Request that we phone a business and book an appointment or reservation within the given time slots. A commissioned job: a skilled, accountable human we brief for you – quoted individually, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually, with volume tiers.

booking_type.description: What to book, e.g. table for 4, dental check-up, boiler service.

callback_contact.description: Optional: phone/email the business may use for the booking.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

preferred_slots.description: Acceptable dates/times in order of preference.
